user.title: Bosch Connect-Key K 40 RF / Buderus MX400
user.description:
Before submitting, press the WLAN and Wireless buttons simultaneously on your gateway for 1 second (LEDs will briefly flash blue).

Note: Hyphens in the password are automatically stripped.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate K 40 RF
reauth_confirm.description: Please press the WLAN and Wireless buttons on the gateway ({host}) for 1 second again, then enter your password.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure / Rescan K 40 RF
reconfigure.description: Update the host/IP address or trigger a manual search for newly added devices and metrics on the gateway ({host}).

data.prune_orphaned: Manually delete orphaned entities without data

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to gateway. Please check host / IP address and network.
error.different_device: The specified IP address belongs to a different gateway.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials. Please verify login and password from device label.
error.proximity_unproven: Buttons were not pressed or the 5-minute pairing window expired. Press WLAN and Wireless buttons for 1 second.
error.token_database_full: Gateway token database is full (max 10 tokens). Please revoke unused tokens.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Reconfiguration and search for new entities completed successfully.
